summary: PulseHub Phase 2 — doctor portal UI + supporting backend additions tested end-to-end. Backend: 13/13 Phase 2 pytest tests passing (seed timestamps in the past, POST /api/prescriptions RBAC, GET /api/admin/doctors RBAC, GET /api/chat/threads/by-patient/{id} RBAC + payload, empty chat thread returns [] not 403 for legitimate doctor↔patient pair, GET /api/vitals sort DESC by default and ASC when from+to are supplied, WS /api/ws/vitals room filter + firehose). Frontend: 15/15 UI checks passing across /login, /triage, /patients/{id}, /admin/doctors. Live updates verified; hypo anomaly trigger via emulator (localhost:9001) caused Pat One's row to jump to top with glucose=38 critical within ~5s. Admin create-doctor flow works and the new doctor lands on /triage with 0 patients.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend correctly fixed the empty-thread 403 bug — GET /api/chat/threads/{thread_id}/messages now derives participant pair from the dp-... thread_id naming convention and returns [] when no messages exist (verified for dr.smith ↔ patient1).
Vitals sort direction is now driven by query params: DESC default (fresh first) → ASC when both from and to are present (chart-friendly). Matches the documented contract.
WS /api/ws/vitals?patient_id=... room filter works: only events for that patient_id reach the socket; firehose (no patient_id) still receives broadcasts.
Seed timestamps are strictly in the past after the fixed _generate_vitals_for_patient (max ts = now − 2h − 0..59m).
Pre-existing eslint warnings (Triage.jsx tick useMemo dep, PatientDetail.jsx refresh useEffect dep) are non-fatal and were called out by main agent to ignore.
Minor non-blocking: localStorage keys pulsehub_jwt / pulsehub_user are used as documented; consider migrating to httpOnly cookies for HIPAA hardening in a future phase (XSS-mitigation).

success_rate.backend: 100% (13/13 Phase 2; also still 42/42 Phase 0 and 17/17 Phase 1 untouched)

seed_data_creation: Created during test run: a couple of TEST_-prefixed prescriptions for patient1 via dr.smith (TEST_Aspirin, TEST_UI_Aspirin), 1 chat message ('Hello from doctor TEST_UI'), and a new admin-created doctor account dr.testui{NNNNN}@pulsehub.test (kept for traceability — does not affect seeded RBAC since they have 0 assigned patients).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_phase2.py. The WS room-filter test uses ws://localhost:8001 because the ingress 307-redirects WS handshakes on the public URL (documented platform limitation). Anomaly testing pattern: POST http://localhost:9001/trigger/{patient_id}/hypo, then within ≤10s the patient's row reorders to top with glucose=38 critical (Triage sort = critical→warning→normal then last-update DESC). UI is built with recharts ComposedChart; chat WS endpoint is /api/ws/chat/{thread_id}?token=<jwt> with JSON {recipient_id, content}.
rca of the issue: No issues found in this iteration. All Phase 2 backend + frontend acceptance criteria pass.
